A separate configured reviewer supports the earlier independent-review prerequisite. No material unresolved Decision is supplied, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the manifest/evaluation source-digest distinction and PRD whitespace normalization are explicitly explained by the supplied Service provenance. Historical project reuse is documented without supplying candidate outputs or running a candidate on this bundle. This approval is based solely on the supplied review evidence, not code execution, independent digest recomputation, or a new human attestation.
